scene: The blue spice sparks, revealing three transit platforms hovering beside the roof.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view of the roof edge. On the far left, a red double-decker hover bus floats beside a railed platform. Left-centre stands the silver-haired grandmother in pink tracksuit holding her dog, mouth aglow with blue sparkles. Centre, a sleek hover metro carriage waits. Far right, a yellow flying scooter idles.
